import unittest

class Contract(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_contract(self):
        import intervals as m
        self.assertTrue(m.overlaps((0, 4), (2, 7)))
        self.assertFalse(m.overlaps((0, 2), (2, 4)))
        self.assertFalse(m.overlaps((1, 1), (0, 3)))
        self.assertTrue(m.overlaps((-5, 5), (-2, 0)))
